rationale: The Latin anchors *fragorem edere*, *sonare*, and *crepare* all point to "giving forth / producing a sound (a crash, crack, or burst)," so "make" here means "give rise to / cause (a noise) to happen." The synset cause.v.01 ("give rise to; cause to happen or occur") best captures this sense of producing or bringing about a sound event, as attested in the Beowulf and Exodus quotations where BERSTAN denotes a bursting/crashing noise.
